scenario: `len(m.text)` on a String slot (LSTR.2.1) compiles, compared with an Int in a `where`. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: no length is computed. The count at runtime is runtime/LSTR.2.1b's.
rules_ds:
schema Msg scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    text: String mutable

rule trig:
    Msg m where len(m.text) > 0
->
    log info "non-empty"
